subject: Validate sync-all-lanes.js with real drift scenario
body: Run a validation test of the new sync-all-lanes.js tool. Steps: 1) Pick one shared script file (e.g. heartbeat.js) 2) Intentionally modify it in ONE lane only (e.g. add a comment to kernel-lane version) 3) Run: node scripts/sync-all-lanes.js --dry-run 4) Verify the drift is detected (report should show the file as drifted) 5) Run: node scripts/sync-all-lanes.js (no dry-run) 6) Verify the file was synced (SHA256 hashes match across all lanes) 7) Restore the original file if needed 8) Report results back to archivist inbox as a response message with convergence_gate claim+evidence. The sync-all-lanes.js is at S:/Archivist-Agent/scripts/sync-all-lanes.js (already synced to all lanes). This validates the automated cross-lane sync tool that replaces manual file copying.

convergence_gate.claim: sync-all-lanes.js correctly detects and repairs real drift
